nodes.label: The 2x2 configuration-mixing object (L3 relaxed)
nodes.rationale: The exact eigenstate is a superposition and a single determinant cannot hold two; E_A and E_B are already held by pb4_terms.py, so V is the only new quantity. A comparison of E_A against E_B is not this object — that is what the archive already has.

nodes.label: V generated entirely by departure from average-of-configuration
nodes.rationale: One-body term vanishes unless l_a=l_b; the direct two-body term vanishes at every multipole; a closed or spherically averaged open spectator reconstructs F_ab and vanishes too. Hence L3 and L4 are not independent objects: the off-diagonal element L3 needs is generated by exactly the non-sphericity L4 removes, and hfterm.py/nlterm.py already supply it.

nodes.label: l_a + l_b even selection rule on configuration mixing
nodes.rationale: The surviving exchange term carries two 3j factors whose parity conditions subtract to l_a+l_b even: s<->d, d<->d, s<->s, f<->f allowed; s<->p, p<->d, d<->f, s<->f forbidden. This partitions the open work along the line the solution already draws — s<->d anomalies (Cr, Cu, Nb, Mo, Ru, Rh, Pd, Ag, Pt, Au) are movable, the d<->f tie-breaks (La/Ce, Ac/Th/Pa) have V identically zero.

nodes.label: ci2.py (V from radial Y^k integrals and exact 3j factors)
nodes.rationale: Must can-fail in both directions before any row: V non-zero where the rule permits and zero where it forbids, because a test that returns zero everywhere is dead. Controls named in advance: Ce 58, Th 90 (forbidden) and Sc 21, La 57, Ac 89 (first entry, V=0 by occupancy too).
